CRP 3 would give 4 legs but its rate bound 8/11 = 0.727 is below the 0.764 cap, and CRED 8 is the hard landing depth. A shared-head tree form does not shorten the far legs (the head lands at the column centroid, ~770 um from lnl3's pin). So I wrote no RTL; a bench would only prove an equivalence that buys no timing
